expected.title: Skirt Steak Salad with Arugula and Blue Cheese
ingredients_contains: 1 pound skirt steak, trimmed of excess fat if necessary, halved crosswise, at room temperature

Steakhouse Mustard Vinaigrette
1 tablespoon coarse Dijon mustard
instructions_contains: Pat steak dry and season on both sides
In a cast-iron skillet: Heat skillet on medium-high to high
On a grill: Prepare grill for direct-heat cooking
Transfer steak to a cutting board and let rest
Whisk ingredients. Season with salt and pepper
